description: Source code for the TOutputVulkanGLSL class, which handles outputting Vulkan-compatible GLSL shader code within the ANGLE project. Contains methods for writing layout qualifiers, qualifiers, variable types, and struct types specific to Vulkan GLSL.

classes.name: TOutputVulkanGLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Vulkan GLSL shader code, extending TOutputGLSL with Vulkan-specific layout and qualifier handling.

methods.name: writeLayoutQualifier
methods.description: Outputs layout qualifiers for shader variables, handling interface blocks and custom layouts for Vulkan GLSL.

methods.name: writeFieldLayoutQualifier
methods.description: Intended to handle layout qualifiers on interface block fields, but currently does nothing as Vulkan GLSL doesn't support them.

methods.name: writeQualifier
methods.description: Outputs qualifiers for shader variables, with special handling for interface blocks and Vulkan-specific qualifiers.

methods.name: writeVariableType
methods.description: Outputs the type of a shader variable, with adjustments for external textures in Vulkan.

methods.name: writeStructType
methods.description: Outputs struct type definitions if they haven't been declared yet.
